plugins.name: nerv
plugins.description: Nerv by Gentle-AI: governance overlay on gentle-ai (Evangelion-named multi-agent workflow) — per-task MAGI vote, governance veto, quality gate, ranked audit, run summary

plugins.name: release
plugins.description: NERV releases, versioning and deploys: computes the next version natively (no semantic-release), builds, tests and packages each project in a throwaway clone of origin into a local artifact, then deploys it: the release commit, tag and push, the images, the targets and the git host's release

plugins.name: release-bash
plugins.description: Script build for nerv release: each pipeline stage runs the project's own command (bash, pwsh or node), and the images it builds are saved into the artifact

plugins.name: release-conventional-commits
plugins.description: Conventional Commits version engine for nerv release: semantic-release 24 with the conventionalcommits preset, natively in Go (no node or npm); installed with release

plugins.name: release-docker-compose
plugins.description: Docker compose build for nerv release: docker compose build, the test service with docker compose run, and the images saved into the artifact

plugins.name: release-github
plugins.description: GitHub git host for nerv deploy: creates the GitHub release of a deployed tag with the gh CLI; installed with release

plugins.name: release-script
plugins.description: Script target for nerv deploy: runs the repository's own deploy script (and optional publish and verify scripts) from the release commit, with the request on stdin and the deploy variables in its environment; installed with release

plugins.name: release-ssh-compose
plugins.description: SSH and docker compose target for nerv deploy: pushes the artifact's images, updates the container with the host's compose script and verifies its health and version; installed with release

plugins.name: task
plugins.description: NERV task tracking: /task:* commands, local timers, and the event dispatcher that hands NERV pipeline events to the installed task providers

plugins.name: task-teamwork
plugins.description: Teamwork provider for the NERV task extension: assigns, moves stages, logs time and creates tasks in Teamwork
